learning_outcomes.text: The student understands the specific A.I. jargon related to Frameworks.
The student explains the differences between the various Frameworks.
The student applies the knowledge of different A.I. Frameworks in practical exercises.
The student studies various A.I. frameworks.
Based on the course 'Python for A.I', the student will delve deeper into Pandas, Numpy, Matplotlib, Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, Pytorch, Fastai, Watson and others.

The student studies and applies advanced A.I. techniques such as transfer-learning, GPU vs CPU hardware platforms/software libraries, explainability (explaining why a model comes to a certain result).
The student explains ethical Machine Learning principles.

syllabus_topics: Overview of several Python packages and Framework implementations: NumPy, Pandas, MatPlotLib, Scikit-learn, Tensorflow, PyTorch, Fastai and others.
Practical execution of the different steps of the application development cycle in an A.I. Framework environment.
Studying the differences in CPU/GPU and other HW-platforms.
Studying the differences between software platforms that support A.I.
The importance of data quality and the data-pipeline.

assessment_methods.method: Partial or continuous assessment with exam during the exam period
Oral defense of a working AI application

assessment_rules: The evaluation is spread throughout the semester. Several tasks (between 2-4) are assigned to each student (50% of the points). The student works on a working AI-app during the semester, which is defended orally during the exam period (50% of the points). For a resit, an improved version of all assigned tasks must be submitted before the start of the resit period (50% of the points), and the final AI-app must be finalized and evaluated during an oral defense (50% of the points). There are no partial transfers for this course unit.
